entries.zh: 沉思，凝神默想；默观（天主教语境指心祷默想）
entries.en: to contemplate, to meditate on; to gaze in absorbed thought
entries.notes: M 栏四音节与 H 栏五字不对应，下方另有划删大字，原对应不齐；据 L 栏及「想入神」定沉思义。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; sense uncertain〕
entries.notes: 四栏皆空，仅存重复词头 Contemplar，无汉字无音写可据。

entries.zh: 巧言周旋，以好言敷衍迁就
entries.en: to temporize with fair words; to smooth-talk, to placate with soft words
entries.notes: H 栏「尖嘴」字面为利口巧嘴，取其巧言义以合 L 栏 buenas palabras；M 首音节声调污损（T99）。

entries.en: glad, joyful; inner gladness
entries.notes: R 栏 sïē 与「忭」音不合，M 栏右旁另有残注 oor 难辨；义据 H 栏「忭」与 L 栏。

entries.en: glad, rejoicing; inwardly pleased
joy, gladness; delighted
joy, gladness; pleased
pleased, delighted
entries.notes: M 栏首字母 v/o 存疑，R 栏 xiē 与「悦」音不合。

entries.en: joy, happiness, gladness
entries.notes: M 栏作 chǒg lǒ（即「作乐」），与 H 栏单字「乐」不合，疑注文羼入；右上另有残注。

entries.en: glad, delighted; to take delight in something
to make merry, to rejoice; merrymaking

entries.zh: 宁静，安于自己的境遇而心安
entries.en: tranquil, at peace; content with one's condition
entries.notes: L 栏「conqu estado」当为「con su estado」；M 栏首字母 t/l/n 存疑。

entries.en: to be content with one's lot; to know one's place

entries.zh: 安守本分，安于自己的身份地位
entries.en: to keep to one's proper station; content with one's lot
entries.notes: L 栏「despav3ado, lvestados」词形残损难辨，义据 H/M/R 三栏「安本分」定。

entries.zh: 本分，分内之责；本人的身份地位
entries.en: one's duty, one's proper place; one's lot
to keep to one's place; to observe one's duty
entries.notes: L 栏 ofuerſo/ofuerio 难辨，M 首音节上有墨渍；义据 H/M/R 三栏。

entries.zh: 守拙，安于质朴寒微（不慕荣利）
entries.en: to keep to one's humble station; content with a plain and lowly life
entries.notes: L 栏 viiestad/vilestad 残疑，若读作 vil estado（卑微身份）则与「守拙」相合；R 栏声调污损。

entries.zh: 春风满面，形容神情舒畅和悦
entries.en: genial and relaxed; cheerful, as if in a spring breeze
entries.notes: H 栏「春风」为比喻义，与 L 栏 descansado（舒泰）相应；L 栏 s 处墨渍，M 栏有残注。

entries.en: to continue, to carry on; to receive and continue
entries.notes: R 栏首字母 s/z 存疑，属音写问题，不影响义。

entries.zh: 赐予，赏赐（西语词形残损，全条语义存疑）
entries.en: to bestow, to grant (headword corrupt; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L 栏 conftan:dar 词形残破，H 栏「赐」与 Continuar 义不合，仅据 H/M 定赐予义，存疑。
